About Routbreak

Source: vignettes/about.Rmd
about.Rmd

Authors

Routbreak is authored and maintained by Boxuan Wang. Eugenio Valdano is a contributor. These roles follow the package metadata in DESCRIPTION.

Scientific framework

The mathematical framework implemented by Routbreak is described in:

Wang B, Valdano E (2026). Redefining and estimating the early-phase reproduction ratio for epidemic outbreaks in spatially structured populations. PLOS Computational Biology, 22(7), e1014425. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014425

The package documentation distinguishes the software citation from the scientific paper. In an installed package, run:

citation("Routbreak")
## Please cite the Routbreak software and its scientific framework
## separately as appropriate.
## 
##   Wang B (2026). Routbreak: Outbreak Reproduction Ratios in Spatially
##   Structured Populations. R package version 0.3.0.
## 
##   Wang B, Valdano E (2026). Redefining and estimating the early-phase
##   reproduction ratio for epidemic outbreaks in spatially structured
##   populations. PLOS Computational Biology, 22(7), e1014425.
##   doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014425
## 
## To see these entries in BibTeX format, use 'print(<citation>,
## bibtex=TRUE)', 'toBibtex(.)', or set
## 'options(citation.bibtex.max=999)'.

Routbreak does not currently have a software DOI.

License and source

The Routbreak software is released under the MIT License. That license applies to the package source and does not grant rights to third-party research data. The public repository does not include Meta colocation data, Canadian transmission-tree data, SEPIAR input data, or POLYMOD survey records.

Source code and issue tracking are available at https://github.com/peasantxuan/Routbreak.
